notes: ASMC's regional haze situation report states widespread hotspots were detected in West, Central and South Kalimantan with moderate to dense smoke plumes, smoke drifting from West Kalimantan into western Sarawak (Malaysia), and dry conditions forecast to prevail over southern Sumatra, central/southern Borneo and Java, with risk of escalated transboundary haze.
recommended_action: Offer HydraShield wildfire + drought monitoring and SMS alerts to plantation, forestry and logistics operators in Kalimantan/Sumatra and to Malaysian agencies tracking transboundary haze.
